question: In a certain code, ROAR is written as URDU. How will URDU be written in that code?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'ROAR' is written as 'URDU'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c185136f2ba249d334af5a71dd9fb64110eb0e740b74b2c92bc695ee3c0e9ead.png] 

Similarly, for 'URDU'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f991e743c334513b0ef5208d4e727479e2fa781045a3100a9e4fc26c841c755.png] 

So, 'URDU' is written as '**XUGX**'

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
